steps.sub: See spend in real time and attribute it to the right team or project

steps.label: 2. Optimize
steps.sub: Act on that visibility — cut waste, right-size, use commitment discounts

steps.label: 3. Operate
steps.sub: Set goals and ownership, then feed improvements back into the next Inform cycle

# Inform asks three questions, continuously:
#  - Where is the money going right now?
#  - Who is accountable for that resource?
#  - Is spend tracking against the forecast and budget?
#
# Nothing in Optimize or Operate works without this phase
caption: A team can't optimize spend it can't see, or hold anyone accountable for spend it can't attribute.

steps.label: Finance

steps.label: Engineering
steps.sub: Has the actual ability to right-size, re-architect, or shut a resource down

steps.label: Business/Product
steps.sub: Supplies context — a spend increase tied to real growth isn't the same as waste
